---
title: Cancellation policy
audiences: [ANY]
category: TERMS
phrasings:
  - can I cancel my booking
  - refund if I cancel
  - cancellation fee
  - get my money back
---

You may cancel free of charge up to 30 days before departure. Between 29 and 15 days we keep 30 percent, inside 14 days 70 percent, and from 3 days before the full price. The refund reaches your card within 10 working days.
